hypotheses.statement: The increase in settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers at 15:55:00Z caused database connection pool exhaustion because the pool size remained at 20, leading to pool_timeout errors.

The expiry of the service token for flags.internal at 15:59:00Z caused 401 invalid_token responses, leading to settlement failures because the worker fails closed when unable to read the settlement_v2_enabled flag.
The two faults—connection pool exhaustion and service token expiry—were independent and coincidental, occurring four minutes apart, and both contributed to the elevated settlement failure ratio.

observed_facts.statement: Configuration change at 15:55:00Z raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers, and the database connection pool size was left at 20 and is not derived from the worker count.
settlement-worker: database connection pool exhausted from 15:58:10Z. Pool size 20, checked-out 20, queue depth rising. Errors: pool_timeout after 5000ms. Affects approximately 0.38 of attempts.
The service token settlement-worker uses for flags.internal was issued for 90 days on 2025-11-13 and expired at 15:59:00Z on 2026-02-11. Its renewal was not automated.

settlement-worker: calls to flags.internal returning 401 invalid_token from 15:59:02Z. The worker fails closed when it cannot read the settlement_v2_enabled flag. Affects approximately 0.31 of attempts, overlapping with pool_timeout failures on some attempts.
Alert settlement-failures fired at 16:00:44Z. Settlement attempts failing reached 0.61 against an objective of 0.02. The alert did not clear until 18:12:30Z.
INC-2201 opened at 16:05:00Z, severity 1, title 'Settlements failing'. The ticket records no settlement value at risk and no such figure was added before resolution.
settlement-worker: connection pool raised to 64 at 17:20:15Z. pool_timeout errors stopped. Settlement failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29 and did not fall further.
Series settlement_failure_ratio: 0.61 from 16:00Z, stepping down to 0.29 at 17:20Z and to 0.004 at 18:12Z. The series shows two distinct step changes, each aligned with a different remediation.
settlement-worker: a replacement token for flags.internal was installed at 18:12:10Z. 401 responses stopped and the settlement failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.

open_questions.missing_evidence: Documentation or configuration source code explaining why the database connection pool size is not derived from worker concurrency.
open_questions.question: Why is the database connection pool size not derived from the worker concurrency?

open_questions.missing_evidence: Inventory or audit report of all service tokens, their renewal policies, and automation status.
open_questions.question: Which other service tokens are on manual renewal and have not been audited?

summary: Incident dual-cause-payments was caused by two independent, coincidental faults: 1) Database connection pool exhaustion due to a worker concurrency increase without a corresponding pool size adjustment, and 2) Expiry of a feature-flag service token on manual renewal. The pool exhaustion caused timeout errors, and the token expiry caused 401 errors, both leading to settlement failures. Remediation occurred in two steps: enlarging the connection pool resolved the first fault, and replacing the token resolved the second, restoring normal operation.

timeline.statement: Configuration change raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers; database connection pool size remained at 20.
Database connection pool exhausted, causing pool_timeout errors affecting ~0.38 of settlement attempts.
Service token for flags.internal expired; renewal was not automated.
Calls to flags.internal started returning 401 invalid_token, affecting ~0.31 of attempts, overlapping with pool_timeout failures.
Alert fired as settlement failure ratio reached 0.61 (objective 0.02).
INC-2201 opened with severity 1, title 'Settlements failing'.
Connection pool raised to 64; pool_timeout errors stopped; failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29.
Replacement token for flags.internal installed; 401 responses stopped; failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.
